text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Apply the recall gate to every campaign run**

When `--runs` is greater than 1, this branch returns success whenever no run threw, even if one or every successful record fails `recallGate` (for example, fewer than six defects found or an unexpected false positive). This breaks the approved plan's requirement that an all-successful campaign retain the existing recall gate and lets scripted multi-run campaigns report exit 0 for failing results; evaluate `recallGate` across all successful records in addition to checking failure records.
